name: 37122 · Mount Juliet, TN
findings: ZIP 37122 (Mount Juliet) has 193 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37122 (Mount Juliet) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37122 (Mount Juliet) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
